title: Lead - Data & Reporting
jobDescription: We are looking for an experienced Lead – Data & Reporting with 8 –12+ years of experience to own and drive the Data & Reporting function for a client-facing enterprise application. The role requires someone who can lead a team, build confidence with stakeholders, ensure high-quality reporting, and establish strong governance around reporting deliverables. The candidate should be equally comfortable working with SQL and reporting technologies while managing client communication, cross-functional collaboration, planning, estimation, and end-to-end delivery ownership.

title: ServiceNow Architect
jobDescription: Looking for a ServiceNow Architect with 14+ years of overall IT experience, including 6+ years in ServiceNow architecture, design, and implementation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in ITSM, CSM, Domain Separation, CMDB, Discovery, integrations, data migration, and platform governance, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions.

title: Business Systems Designer
jobDescription: We are seeking a Business Systems Designer, you will transform how our clients work by uncovering hidden inefficiencies and designing systems that cut wasted time and unlock growth. You will lead discovery sessions to map current chaos, then architect future-state workflows that executives can understand and our developers can effectively build. Working alongside Project Managers and Automation Developers, you will be technical enough to design systems that work, but business-savvy enough to sell the vision, without getting bogged down in the actual implementation.
